english: Wh-! If that's how it is,\nI won't lose either!
You two there, don't break formation!\nYou're pushing too far ahead!
What, don't sweat the small stuff!
What do you think strategy is for, you lot!
If you're scared, you can hang back, y'know?
Indeed, the weak may\nhide behind me!
Oh... big talk...\nI'll show you which of us is weak!
Yeah... in this situation,\nsaying you're not anxious at all\nwould be a lie, I think.
Even I get scared\nthinking about what happens next...
But we have the power to fight -\nIS. We can't run away first, so\nmaybe that's why they're charging ahead like that...
I doubt they're thinking that far ahead...
But still, being able to act like always -\nthat's our strength.
Uh, oh no... this looks bad...\nwe're totally surrounded.
Hey! Ganging up on us is cowardly!
Tch! What are you doing!\nThat's why I said don't charge ahead...
(We have the power to fight...\nthe power to end this chaos...\nto protect everyone's future...)
